# PuTTY test vectors

The `.ppk` files were generated by `puttygen` and are taken from the test
suite of [kayrus/putty](https://github.com/kayrus/putty) (`putty_test.go`,
Apache-2.0). The encrypted ones use the passphrase `testkey`.

- `ed25519-v2-aes.ppk` — PPK v2, aes256-cbc
- `rsa-v3-none.ppk` — PPK v3, unencrypted
- `rsa-v3-argon2id-aes.ppk` — PPK v3, Argon2id + aes256-cbc
